content: 1. Lopinavir's level or effect can be reduced by altering hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely when co-administering with drugs like quetiapine, as both can increase each other's toxicity via QTc interval prolongation. Avoid using with drugs that prolong QT interval or in patients with risk factors for QT prolongation. Post-marketing cases have reported QT prolongation with overdose in patients with concurrent illnesses or drugs causing electrolyte imbalance or QT prolongation. 2. Lopinavir and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Quinupristin/dalfopristin can increase lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 3. Lopinavir increases the level or effect of quizartinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Reduce quizartinib dosage to 4 mg/day when co-administered with strong CYP3A inhibitors. Interrupt quizartinib during the use of strong CYP3A inhibitors. 4. Lopinavir increases the level or effect of repaglinide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 5. Ribociclib increases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 6. Rifapentine decreases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 7. Lopinavir increases rifaximin levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. 8. Lopinavir increases rilpivirine levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rilpivirine increases lopinavir toxicity via QTc interval prolongation. Avoid co-administration with drugs that increase the risk of Torsade de Pointes. 9. Ritonavir increases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 10. Lopinavir increases rivaroxaban levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid concomitant use with combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inhibitors due to increased bleeding risk. 11. Lopinavir decreases roflumilast's level or effect by affecting CYP1A2 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 12. Lopinavir increases roflumilast topical levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 13. Lopinavir decreases rosiglitazone's effects, potentially due to insulin resistance caused by protease inhibitors. Use caution and monitor closely. 14. Rucaparib increases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 15. Rufinamide decreases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Lopinavir increases saxagliptin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 17. Lopinavir increases seladelpar levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 18. Selpercatinib increases lopinavir toxicity via QTc interval prolongation. Use caution and monitor closely. 19. Lopinavir increases sertraline levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially increasing toxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. 20. Lopinavir decreases sitagliptin's effects, potentially due to insulin resistance caused by protease inhibitors. Use caution and monitor closely. 21. Magnesium sulfate/potassium chloride increases lopinavir toxicity via QTc interval prolongation. Consider preand post-colonoscopy ECGs in high-risk patients. 22. Sodium sulfate/potassium sulfate/magnesium sulfate increases lopinavir toxicity via QTc interval prolongation. Consider preand post-colonoscopy ECGs in high-risk patients. 23. Sorafenib and lopinavir both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 24. Stiripentol affects lopinavir's metabolism via CYP3A4 inhibition and induction. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 25. Lopinavir increases sufentanil levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially causing fatal respiratory depression. Use caution and monitor closely. 26. Lopinavir increases tacrolimus ointment levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 27. Lopinavir increases talazoparib levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. 28. Lopinavir increases tamsulosin levels by affecting CYP2D6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 29. Lopinavir increases tasimelteon levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 30. Tazemetostat decreases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 31. Tecovirimat decreases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 32. Lopinavir increases terbinafine levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 33. Lopinavir increases tezacaftor levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 34. Lopinavir increases ticagrelor levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid use with strong CYP3A inhibitors. 35. Lopinavir increases timolol levels by affecting CYP2D6 metabolism, increasing the risk of PR prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias. Use caution and monitor closely. 36. Lopinavir increases toremifene levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 37. Lopinavir increases tramadol levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 38. Lopinavir and triclabendazole both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 39. Lopinavir increases trimipramine levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 40. Lopinavir increases umeclidinium bromide/vilanterol inhaled levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 41. Lopinavir increases upadacitinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 42. Lopinavir increases valbenazine levels by affecting CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 43. Lopinavir increases vardenafil levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 44. Lopinavir increases venlafaxine levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially increasing toxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. 45. Verapamil increases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 46. Lopinavir increases vilanterol/fluticasone furoate inhaled levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 47. Lopinavir increases vinorelbine levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 48. Lopinavir and voclosporin both increase QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 49. Lopinavir decreases warfarin's level or effect by affecting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 51. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 53. Lopinavir increases zileuton levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially increasing toxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. 54. Lopinavir increases zolpidem levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 55. Lopinavir decreases zuranolone's level or effect by affecting CYP2E1 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 56. Acetazolamide increases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 57. Anastrozole increases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 58. Lopinavir increases cilostazol levels by decreasing its metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 59. Cyclophosphamide increases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 60. Danazol increases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 61. Drospirenone increases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 62. Lopinavir and ganaxolone interaction via CYP3A4 metabolism is not expected to be clinically significant. 63. Lopinavir and ixazomib co-administration with strong CYP3A inhibitors does not result in clinically meaningful changes in ixazomib exposure. 64. Larotrectinib increases lopinavir's level or effect by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 65. Lopinavir increases selexipag levels by decreasing its metabolism. This interaction is likely of little clinical significance. 66. Lopinavir increases abemaciclib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 67. Lopinavir increases adagrasib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 68. Lopinavir decreases acarbose's effects due to pharmacodynamic antagonism. Use caution and monitor closely.
